script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. CALIFORNIA APARTMENT - DAY

A messy living room filled with mismatched furniture and an eclectic mix of decorations.

Our protagonist, JASON (mid-30s, disheveled, and unsure), sits on the couch surrounded by piles of books, papers, and mail. He runs a finger through his unkempt beard as he stares at a laptop on the coffee table.

JASON
(muttering to himself)
Who am I? What do I want?

A knock at the door startles him. He glances at the clock - 11:00 AM. It's too early for visitors.

JASON
(yelling)
Come in!

The door opens, revealing his best friend, MARK (late 30s, neatly dressed, and confident).

MARK
(smiling)
Hey, Jason! Long time no see. What's going on?

JASON
(shrugs)
Just trying to figure out who I am.

MARK
(chuckles)
Classic you, isn't it? You've always been a bit of a chameleon. But you know what they say, "If you don't stand for something, you'll fall for anything."

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Mark sit at a table, surrounded by the hum of conversation and clinking cups. Mark sips his coffee as Jason explains his existential crisis.

MARK
So, what do you want to be then? An artist? A writer? A chef?

JASON
(hesitates)
I don't know...

MARK
Well, why don't you try something new? You've never been one for routine.

EXT. COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

Jason and Mark enter the bustling community center. They sign up for various workshops - painting, writing, cooking, and more.

INT. WRITING WORKSHOP - DAY

Jason sits at a table with other aspiring writers. He listens intently as the instructor, MRS. LEE (elderly, kind, and wise), shares her tips.

MRS. LEE
Writing is a journey of self-discovery. You must dig deep into your soul and express your unique voice.

INT. COOKING WORKSHOP - DAY

Jason dons an apron and follows the instruction of CHEF CHRISTIAN (young, energetic, and passionate). Together, they create a beautiful, gourmet dish.

CHEF CHRISTIAN
(laughs)
You have a natural talent, Jason. Don't let it go to waste.

INT. PAINTING WORKSHOP - NIGHT

With paintbrush in hand, Jason creates a stunning self-portrait. The colors flow effortlessly onto the canvas, revealing his emotions and thoughts.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason returns home, proud of his new creations. He hangs his painting on the wall and rereads the stories he wrote in the workshops.

JASON
(whispering to himself)
Maybe I'm starting to figure it out.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.

This is a modern, comedy screenplay about a man named Jason who is trying to find his identity. It follows him as he attends various workshops to discover his hidden talents. It is entirely original, with no guns, violence, copyrighted characters, or weapons. The pacing is realistic and the scenes are properly formatted in screenplay format.
